import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet');c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages
def est(d,cut=1876):
  t=d.assign(late=d.year>=cut).groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack().dropna();return (t[True]-t[False]).mean()
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);grp=[x for _,x in w.assign(late=w.year>=1876).groupby(['genre','late'])];bs=[]
for i in range(2000):
  s=pd.concat([x.iloc[rng.integers(0,len(x),len(x))] for x in grp]);bs.append(est(s))
print(est(w),np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]),np.mean(np.array(bs)<=0))
print('high',est(w[w.date_confidence=='high']),'nolow',est(w[w.date_confidence!='low']))
print('drop other/coll',est(w[~w.genre.isin(['other','collection'])]))
for k in [1856,1866,1886,1896]: print(k,est(w,k))
print('origin',[ (o,est(w[w.origin==o])) for o in ['UK','US','unknown']])
print(w.groupby('decade').r.mean().round(3).to_dict())
print(w[w[c]>0].sort_values('date_confidence').query('year>=1876').sample(4,random_state=1).sample_passage_ids.tolist())
print(w[(w[c]>0)&(w.year<1876)].sample(3,random_state=1).sample_passage_ids.tolist())
